title: A visit to the repair café

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Good morning, Westbrook Repair Café. This is Maya speaking. How can I help?

turns.speaker: Owen
turns.text: I'm calling about the workshop this Saturday. I thought it was at the library on King Street. Is that still right?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: We've moved to the community centre. It has a larger room and a separate entrance on Mill Lane.

turns.speaker: Owen
turns.text: Great. Could I bring in a lamp? It still switches on, but the shade keeps slipping.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: A lamp is fine. Bring a photograph of the label underneath, please. That will let our volunteer check the model before taking anything apart.

turns.speaker: Owen
turns.text: Do I need to book a time? I can be there at ten or just after lunch.

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Please book for twelve thirty. We open at ten, but our electrical volunteer won't arrive until midday.

turns.speaker: Owen
turns.text: And how much does it cost?

turns.speaker: Maya
turns.text: Advice is free. If we need a replacement part, we'll tell you the price before ordering it. Bring the lamp, the label photo and a bag for any loose parts.

questions.prompt: Use no more than two words. The entrance is on ___.
questions.explanation: Maya confirms the new entrance is on Mill Lane.

questions.prompt: What is Owen asked to photograph?
questions.explanation: A photograph of the label helps check the model first.

questions.prompt: Write the booking time, for example 10:00.
questions.explanation: The opening time is ten, but the booking is at twelve thirty.

questions.prompt: What might Owen have to pay for?
questions.explanation: Advice is free and a required replacement part can be charged.
